property_summary: After any successful setL1BlockValues call by the depositor, batcherHash must equal the supplied _batcherHash argument for every input; the mutant stores bytes32(0) instead, breaking this for any nonzero _batcherHash.
change_summary: Replace the assignment `batcherHash = _batcherHash;` with `batcherHash = bytes32(0);` so batcherHash is set to zero instead of the supplied value.
